---
title: "五／六／七串一不替换：逐期收益相关性"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  cache: false
  freeze: false
  error: false
params:
  study: "data/derived/fundamentals_417/n5-single-swaps-v1"
  output: "data/derived/fundamentals_417/n5-n6-n7-correlations-v1"
  archived_report: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
source("r/fundamentals_pure_report.R")
loaded<-read_pure_baseline_report(params$study,params$archived_report)
rows<-bind_rows(as_tibble(loaded$result$rows) |> filter(policy=="N5_NO_SWAP"),
 as_tibble(loaded$result$controls))
issues<-unlist(loaded$result$issue_order)
policies<-c("N5_NO_SWAP","N6_UNCAPPED","U3_BASELINE","U6_BASELINE")
stopifnot(length(issues)==48,!anyDuplicated(issues),nrow(rows)==192,
 !anyDuplicated(rows[c("issue","policy")]),setequal(rows$policy,policies),
 !anyNA(rows[c("net","hits","stake")]),all(is.finite(rows$net)))
expected<-expand_grid(issue=issues,policy=policies)
stopifnot(nrow(anti_join(expected,rows,by=c("issue","policy")))==0)
net<-rows |> select(issue,policy,net) |> pivot_wider(names_from=policy,values_from=net)
net<-as.matrix(net[match(issues,net$issue),policies])
hit<-rows |> mutate(hit=as.integer(hits>0)) |> select(issue,policy,hit) |>
 pivot_wider(names_from=policy,values_from=hit)
hit<-as.matrix(hit[match(issues,hit$issue),policies])
stopifnot(!anyNA(net),!anyNA(hit))
pearson<-stats::cor(net)
spearman<-stats::cor(net,method="spearman")
phi<-stats::cor(hit)
pairs<-combn(seq_along(policies),2)
comparison<-tibble()
for (k in seq_len(ncol(pairs))) {
 i<-pairs[1,k];j<-pairs[2,k]
 comparison<-bind_rows(comparison,tibble(first=policies[i],second=policies[j],
  pearson=pearson[i,j],spearman=spearman[i,j],hit_phi=phi[i,j],
  both_hit=sum(hit[,i]==1 & hit[,j]==1),first_only=sum(hit[,i]==1 & hit[,j]==0),
  second_only=sum(hit[,i]==0 & hit[,j]==1),neither=sum(hit[,i]==0 & hit[,j]==0)))
}
stopifnot(all(comparison$both_hit+comparison$first_only+comparison$second_only+comparison$neither==48))
```

同48期按期号严格配对，比较每期净收益金额，包含未下注期的零收益。
五、六串一均无有效U限制、不替换；七串一保留原U3/U6限制、不替换。
单选均按两源Top1一致、市场概率筛选，双选为基线Top2；排除零让球Top2分歧。
五／六串一每期最多64／32组，组间最多重叠4／5场；七串一沿用原组。各版本实际投入不同。
Pearson反映金额的线性同向变化；Spearman反映排序的同向变化，降低少数大额收益的影响。
没有对累计资金曲线计算相关性，也没有将未下注期的ROI强行设为零。
这是已暴露历史的描述性统计，不用于学习、调参或自动资金分配。

## 每期净收益 Pearson 相关性

```{r}
knitr::kable(pearson,digits=3)
```

## 每期净收益 Spearman 相关性

```{r}
knitr::kable(spearman,digits=3)
```

## 中奖期重合情况

hit_phi为“本期是否至少有一个组中奖”的二元相关性。命中不等于盈利。
first_only、second_only分别为仅第一个、仅第二个版本命中的期数。

```{r}
comparison |> select(first,second,hit_phi,both_hit,first_only,second_only,neither) |>
 knitr::kable(digits=3)
```

低相关并不自动带来较小回撤；组合收益还取决于实际权重、共同亏损时段和投入。
48期且策略共享场次，结果只描述当前样本，不解释为独立样本的显著性或未来稳定关系。

```{r}
#| include: false
dir.create(params$output,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
readr::write_csv(comparison,file.path(params$output,"correlations.csv"))
bindings<-c(file.path(params$study,c("results.json","plans-frozen.json")),
 "quarto/115_n5_n6_n7_correlations.qmd","r/fundamentals_pure_report.R")
hashes<-list()
for (f in bindings) hashes[[f]]<-digest::digest(file=f,algo="sha256")
jsonlite::write_json(list(source_seal=loaded$receipt$plan_freeze_seal,hashes=hashes,
 issues=issues,policies=policies,observations="issue_net_cny_and_any_group_hit",
 generated_at=format(Sys.time(),tz="UTC",usetz=TRUE),historical_admission=FALSE),
 file.path(params$output,"provenance.json"),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
```
